scope: Timeline contract of the inactivity observer and the provider isolation of the instrumentation.

packageGraph.statement: Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics is a direct core dependency on every target framework, with the version owned by Directory.Packages.props and no PrivateAssets or runtime exclusion.

mutationProbes.assurance: TimeoutTask does not wait out a full period before honouring a forced completion
mutationProbes.mutation: restore the unconditional first delay in AsyncInactivityObserver.TimeoutTask
mutationProbes.result: 3 cases red, among them 'Now() must render the timeline without waiting out the inactivity period'

mutationProbes.assurance: An unbound context does not reach the state of the explicit non dependency injection path
mutationProbes.mutation: GetInstrumentation returns the fallback state instead of null when a context carries no binding
mutationProbes.result: 1 of 10 red: Should_not_attach_an_unbound_context_to_the_non_dependency_injection_state, 'An unbound context must not reach the explicit non dependency injection state'

mutationProbes.assurance: Configuring a provider does not rebind a root context another scope already uses
mutationProbes.mutation: TryConfigure(IServiceProvider) binds LogContext.Current instead of the root context of its own scope
mutationProbes.result: 1 of 11 red: Should_not_rebind_a_root_context_that_another_scope_already_uses, 'No provider state may be reachable through the instance the application established'; the leak lands in the meter of the provider that configured last, which is the last writer wins effect

mutationProbes.assurance: The core registers the standard metric core itself
mutationProbes.mutation: remove the central collection.AddMetrics() call from AddInstrumentation
mutationProbes.result: 4 of 11 red, among them 'The core must register the standard metric core itself' and 'The standard registration must not add a second meter factory' (0 instead of 1)

mutationProbes.assurance: The kill switch restart establishes the context of its own kill switch as the operation boundary
mutationProbes.result: 1 of 1 red on both halves: the identity of the established context and 'The restart must record through the meter scope of its own provider' (0 instead of 1). The probe also proves that the execution context of the arming flow reaches the timer thread, which is the condition under which the old form fails.

mutationProbes.assurance: The outbox delivery loop enters the log context of its own provider before the first await
mutationProbes.result: 1 of 1 red: 'The delivery loop must record through the meter scope of its own provider' (0 instead of 1)

N1_no_global_dependency_injection_latch.statement: No static flag decides whether the dependency injection path configures. Every static field is either a cache keyed per scope, a lock, or the state of the explicit non dependency injection path.
measured_static_fields: static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, string> _labelCache = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<ILogContext, LogContextInstrumentationState> _logContextStates = new ConditionalWeakTable<ILogContext, LogContextInstrumentationState>();
static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<IMeterFactory, Lazy<LogContextInstrumentationState>> _meterFactoryStates = new ConditionalWeakTable<IMeterFactory, Lazy<LogContextInstrumentationState>>();

N2_no_implicit_fallback_for_unbound_cont.statement: The state of the explicit non dependency injection path is only touched by the explicit entry point. The lookup returns null for a context that carries no binding.

N3_no_root_context_rebinding_between_pro.statement: Every binding call names either the root context the scope owns, the current context of the explicit non dependency injection entry point, or a context derived from a bound one.

N4_no_reset_reflection_or_order_helper.statement: No changed product file introduces reflection, a state reset helper or an execution order dependency.

N5_no_public_api_delta.statement: The public surface of the assembly can only change through a changed file, so comparing exactly these files is complete rather than a sample. Effective accessibility is used: a public member of an internal type is not part of the public surface.
N5_no_public_api_delta.head: 8c40db0d86cca3eb750c7d2d5a5583bd1d3db13a

correctionsDisclosed.what: The mixed process case waited for the consume instrument on an endpoint that used a handler.
correctionsDisclosed.measured: consume=0 handler=1 receive=1 for a non dependency injection bus with e.Handler<PingMessage>
correctionsDisclosed.consequence: The case timed out for a reason that had nothing to do with the product, and its isolation assertion could never have filled, so it proved nothing. The endpoint now uses a consumer, which puts both sides on the same instrument and makes the assertion discriminating.

correctionsDisclosed.what: Three identity assertions on the activated root context were removed again.
correctionsDisclosed.measured: LogContext.Current observed from the test flow is unchanged across both providers, with and without the correction
correctionsDisclosed.consequence: LogContext.Current is an AsyncLocal and each provider activates its root inside its own resolution flow, so the activation is not observable from the test flow at all. The assertions were red in both directions and therefore measured nothing. The assurance is carried by the semantic proof instead.

notRun: MongoDB integration, which REQ-CLEAN-003 removes instead of testing
